value: This document provides an overview of the PLUM (Programming Languages at UMD) research group, detailing its current members and their collective research focus. Led by co-directors David Van Horn, Leonidas Lampropoulos, and Milijana Surbatovich, the group's work, encompassing contributions from postdocs and numerous students, spans core areas such as program analysis, formal verification, software security, testing, and type systems, aimed at building correct, reliable, and secure software across various computing platforms. The article also highlights the group's broader impact through its extensive network of alumni, who continue to advance programming languages and related fields in both academia and industry.
